summary: Phase 1 'Make the Construction Workflow Dependable' check, preview build only. Tested: one fresh happy path (API plus full UI) and five negative gates. Regression suite: 155 of the earlier tests pass. The new file test_iter24_phase1_paths.py has 19 tests: 17 pass when run serially, and the 2 that fail are strict checks for the two real deviations below. I fixed one real bug: the partial-quote dependency gate never fired (quote_routes.py queried db.edges, but item links are stored in db.item_edges). RESULTS TABLE: [HAPPY PATH] PASS with 2 deviations. Evidence: fresh visitor ui24-5441715751, new project prj_e5c0e10f766f created in the UI. The chat brief saved name, customer, 2 sites, start date, weeks and Alder's terms with no retyping. The correction 'Actually Alder is $9,500 per site' was saved (price_per_site_cents=950000). Synthetic C-10 evidence (holder match, source, active, observed today, expiry 2027) gave Fits. Draft plan created no links. Select plan worked, then Request review. Alder (same visitor) confirmed: 'Response saved against these exact terms'. The quote's condition was decided and Q1 issued to buyer@example.test. In a fresh context, with the synthetic code, the quote was accepted, and it is still Accepted after reload. The organizer's primary action now reads 'View accepted quote'. DEVIATION A: 'Exclude ceiling repairs' typed in chat was not saved (0 of 4 runs), so the quote preview had no 'Ceiling repairs' exclusion. DEVIATION B: 'Alder must hold an active C-10 licence' was saved as Alder's partner condition, not a job condition. The requirement therefore stayed a rule suggestion (sug-C-10), not 'Required by source', and the duplicate open-condition card was not suppressed. [GATE 1 qualification/uncovered] PASS (after my edges fix). Expiry-only evidence gives evidence_needed ('an expiry date alone is not current status'). Observed 'expired' with a future expiry date gives does_not_fit, and plan/select returns 409 '...does not fit...'. Redwood with C-33-only evidence is never drafted. Open S03 stays in coverage.open and not_covered. The partial quote is blocked without partial_ack. The dependency blocker 'S01 depends on open scope S03' fires only after the fix. [GATE 2 reading/private-draft] PASS. POST /links before select returns 409 'Select the plan before sending it for review.' A 30-page, 59,607-char PDF gives coverage reviewed 30/30, queued 0, and facts cite pages 1..30. Advance mode creates no links and selects nothing (iter22 test). [GATE 3 isolated recipients/privacy] PASS with one minor leak. The partner review shows only its own sites and terms (test_assemble_flow test_06, plus UI). The customer view and /ask never show $9,500, $19,000 or the firm name (the ask test asked for Alder's price and margin directly). Birch opening Alder's link gets 403. Minor leak: if a partner condition is marked 'Put in offer', its text, which includes the firm name ('Alder must hold...'), goes into the customer snapshot. [GATE 4 overlapping writes] PASS. A stale rev on plan/assign and on PUT intake returns 409, and the job name was not overwritten. A stale rev on the assistant returns 409. After redraft + preview/select, the partner's old response returns 409 'These terms were replaced by a newer version'. Issuing with a stale digest returns 409. [GATE 5 cancellation/retry] PASS. The 2nd queued run was cancelled and shows 'stopped' with 'Stopped. Nothing was changed.' saved, and the job name is unchanged. In the UI, sending a composer message after an out-of-band rev bump made 2 calls (409, then 200 automatically) with no error toast. NOT RUN (not built): CSLB API lookup, scope splitting, drawing/spec conflict detection, publish. DESIGN: package titles lead with the work ('Pine St lighting: 2 sites') and the firm name is on the next line. Header open-condition count equals the group count (9=9, 8=8 after confirm). At 390px, scrollWidth is 390 on the workspace and the customer quote (no overflow).

critical.issue: A job-wide exclusion typed in chat ('Exclude ceiling repairs') becomes an 'exclusions' fact with partner=null. FIELD_MAP treats exclusions as partner-only, so the fact is marked invalid ('No partner named for this fact.') and dropped. p.exclusions stays empty and the quote preview does not show 'Ceiling repairs'. Seen in 4 of 4 runs.

Only intake.job_conditions are scanned for explicit licence requirements. The reader saves 'Alder must hold an active C-10 licence' as partner.conditions, so no doc-C-10 requirement is created. C-10 stays a dismissable rule suggestion, and the same code also shows as a separate open-condition card (duplicate not suppressed).

minor.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: the dependency check queried db.edges, which does not exist (0 docs). Item links live in db.item_edges, so 'X depends on open scope Y' never fired. Changed to db.item_edges and verified with test_partial_quote_dependency_blocker.

When a partner condition is decided 'in_offer', its raw text (which includes the firm name, e.g. 'Alder must hold...') is copied into the customer snapshot. The snapshot comment says firm names never carry over. Consider redacting the text or rewording it to 'licensed subcontractor'.
job_conditions[].source is stored as a string, so the isinstance(src, dict) branch never runs. Sourced requirements never carry a page citation (page is always None).
observed_on is not checked against the future. A future observed date counts as current 'active' evidence.

After the evidence was recorded and the sites showed Fits, the assistant said 'Alder's C-10 licence condition is source-stated, with no evidence it is verified'. The assistant snapshot seems to leave out qual evidence and fit results.

ui_bugs.issue: The copy reads 'Applies to The job mentions lighting, which is usually C-10...'. The reason text is joined onto 'Applies to'.
No data-testid on this button (the expected inspector-open-qualify was not present for the requirement card). The test had to use the role/name selector.
Grammar: 'TEST Buyer (buyer@example.test) accept Q1 at ...' should read 'accepted'.

integration_issues.flow: Chat brief -> job exclusions -> quote preview
integration_issues.issue: The exclusion typed in chat never reaches the Exclusions list or the quote preview (backend root cause above).

The partner condition card 'Alder must hold an active C-10 licence' stays in Open conditions after the evidence shows Fits and the quote marked it resolved. Counts stay consistent but the card is stale.

issues: The graph zoom controls overlap the '1 package' count label in the Plan frame header (it reads '1 packag').
The expanded Conversation tray covers the lower Open conditions cards until it is collapsed.
Carried over: evidence-firm and evidence-status are native selects, and evidence-expires and evidence-observed-on are native date pickers (not shadcn). The first form row has an empty 5th cell.

action_items: Support job-level exclusions from the reader/chat: map a partner-less 'exclusions' fact to a job exclusion in p.exclusions (like conditions -> job_condition), so 'Exclude ceiling repairs' reaches the quote preview

Make explicit licence statements in partner conditions (or the reader's output) produce 'Required by source': scan partner.conditions in qualify.sourced() (scoped to that firm's sites) or have the reader route licence rules to job_conditions, and suppress sug-C-10 and the duplicate open-condition card
Avoid leaking firm names when a partner condition is put in the customer offer

Optional: give the inspector 'Review requirement' button a data-testid; fix the 'Applies to <reason>' copy; change the receipt text 'accept' to 'accepted'; stop the zoom controls overlapping the Plan count at 390px; reject future observed_on dates
critical_code_review_comments: quote_routes.readiness used the wrong collection name (db.edges vs db.item_edges). The dependency gate was dead code, and no earlier test caught it because none created real item links.
qualify._site_result: if one record is observed-active and another observed-expired for the same class, the active one wins silently. Consider review_needed on conflicting records.
qualify.sourced: the dict-source branch is unreachable because intake normalizes source to a string.
remove_evidence / remove_exclusion still return 200 for unknown ids (carried over).

success_rate.backend: Regression 155/155; new file 17/19 serial (2 strict failures = the 2 real bugs)
success_rate.frontend: Happy path in the UI end to end: all steps pass; exclusion-from-chat and Required-by-source not met

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the new file with '-n 0' for a quick check (about 45s). test_09/test_10 in TestHappyPath are strict checks for the chat exclusion and the Required-by-source requirement. The review link token is not in the DOM (Copy link); read it from db.links or the API. Partner sign-in in the UI: signin-review-as-partner-toggle, then signin-demo-alder-button. Quote: primary-action -> quote-new -> fill fields -> quote-save-preview -> quote-condition-0-resolved -> quote-issue. Customer flow: quote-send-code -> quote-synthetic-code -> quote-code-input -> quote-verify-button -> quote-accept -> quote-signer-name -> quote-intent -> quote-respond-submit.
rca of the issue: (1) Chat exclusion lost: extract_routes FIELD_MAP maps 'exclusions' to ('partner', ...). A partner-less exclusion fact gets the issue 'No partner named for this fact.' and status invalid, and there is no job-exclusion route. Repro: new project, send the brief in chat, then check db.facts: label=Exclusions, status=invalid, project.exclusions=None. Mitigation: add a job_exclusion scope that writes to p.exclusions on apply. (2) Required by source missing: the reader saves the licence sentence as the partner's 'conditions' (partner named), and qualify.sourced() reads only intake.job_conditions. Mitigation: also scan partner.conditions with CODE_RE and create doc requirements scoped to that partner's sites. (3) Dependency gate: wrong collection name, fixed.
